lead: Cheteshwar Pujara is an Indian cricketer, born on 25 January 1988 in Rajkot.
As of 2026, he is 38 years old, and his birth date places him under the Aquarius sign.
He has represented Kolkata Knight Riders and India national cricket team and has been recognised with the Arjuna Award.
The sections that follow break down Cheteshwar Pujara's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.
